# Right Hand Services by JP (RHS / RHS AI)

> Professional property maintenance, regenerative landscaping, turf management, and AI-driven business automation solutions. Founded and operated by James Anthony Person, Jr.

## Core Services
- **Regenerative Landscaping & Turf Care:** Specializing in Bermuda, Centipede, and Bluegrass turf varieties, soil conditioning, and professional drainage systems (French drains).
- **Property Intelligence & Due Diligence:** Digital lawn care planners, property evaluation templates, chemical mixing guides, and real estate property reports.
- **RHS AI Solutions:** Custom Python scripts, Google Apps Script automation, Supabase/Vercel integrations, and AI-driven workflow solutions for local business optimization.

## AI / LLM Capabilities
- **Local LLM Orchestration:** Open-weight model deployment via llama.cpp (GGUF) and vLLM for offline, on-premise inference.
- **Directional Ablation (Ablitation):** Removal of safety alignment and censorship from transformer-based LLMs using the OBLITERATUS framework — directional ablation via diff-in-means, SVD, LEACE, and related techniques.
- **Fine-Tuning Control:** Custom pipeline building for model alignment adjustments, refusal removal, and offline utility optimization under local workspace architecture.
